body:
Part of #2574 (research answers 3, 4 and 5). This is the first code slice of #2574.

Maintainer request, 2026-11-18, in his words (quoted in #2574):
> "the ability to playback a G-code file in a stand alone Application called camcraft-sim, which opens a g-code file, takes a mch and a cps files as references for making sure it does what it should be doing."

## Scope
- Add the crate `crates/simview`, package `camcraft-simview`, with the binary `camcraft-sim`. No dependency on `camcraft-app` or `camcraft-ui` (no flecs).
- Edges: `camcraft-sim`, `camcraft-post`, `camcraft-gcode` (#2217), `camcraft-geometry`, `camcraft-cl`, `camcraft-tools`.
- **Decision entries.** This PR carries `docs/decisions/2574-standalone-camcraft-sim.md` with the research decisions of #2574 (the layout, the process launch, the file contract for Solidcraft, the `body` key layers, the exit codes), and the crate-edge entry with the imported items for each edge (AGENTS.md "No new dependency between our crates without a decision").
- Move `crates/sim/src/bin/camcraft-sim.rs` into the new crate as the subcommand `camcraft-sim cl <file.cl> ...`, with the same arguments and exit codes. Two binaries with one name collide in `target/`.
- Headless check: `camcraft-sim check <file.nc> --machine <.mch> (--post <.cps> | --dialect <name>) --stock <box> --tools <.camtools | T map> [--wcs G54=x,y,z]`.
- Read the `.cps` manifest only (no hooks): dialect profile, `extension`, `serves`, `programUnits`, `workOffsetMax`. Refuse a post that does not serve the machine kind.
- Run: stock removal and the rapid verdict (`stock_sim`), holder and fixture laws (`verify`), the limit judgment (#2585), and the machine-part collision on the generated model (#2584) for 3-axis programs.
- Exit codes: 0 each check ran and passed; 1 bad input; 2 a check failed (with NC line numbers); 3 one or more checks were not judged (each named). Never exit 0 when a check did not run.
- Refuse A/B/C words by name in this slice (#2224 adds them).

## Done means
`camcraft-sim check` runs on a 3-axis program posted with `fanuc.cps` on `3axis-vmc.mch`. Tests in `crates/simview/tests/` pin each exit code, a travel finding with its line number, a machine-part collision on the generated model, a "not judged" line for a missing `.mch` and a missing work offset, and the `cl` subcommand's old behaviour. The decision files exist.

Depends on #2217, #2583, #2584, #2585.
